objective: Upgrade tabletop parcel intake from fixed routes to evidence-derived batch policy with explainable decisions.
acceptance: planner accepts any non-empty parcel batch and scans the complete batch before grasping
only verified intact parcels route to pickup while every observed exception routes to quarantine
quarantine work is ordered before pickup and all single-arm manipulation is serialized
world-model verification independently derives destinations from observed attributes
dashboard explains label, condition, expected route, and actual routing outcome per parcel
evidence: desktop and mobile parcel-decision dashboard screenshots
stop_conditions: conditional execution would require a new contract
mobile navigation or parcel-locker access is requested
scripted observations would be presented as physical sensor evidence
